tools.name: fda_risk_lookup
tools.description: Cross-reference openFDA 510(k), PMA, recalls, and ongoing Class I/II enforcement totals for a medtech company or K-number.

tools.name: sec_8k_radar
tools.description: Extract and classify SEC EDGAR Form 8-K filings by ticker symbol.

tools.name: npi_provider_search
tools.description: Query CMS NPPES v2.1 Healthcare Providers with >=2 criteria (state + taxonomy and/or city, LOCATION address).

tools.name: cisa_kev_priority
tools.description: Prioritize CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities with ransomware and FIRST EPSS enrichment.

tools.name: openapi_breaking_diff
tools.description: Deterministically diff two OpenAPI 3.x JSON objects for path/method/parameter breaking changes.

tools.name: usaspending_expiring_contracts
tools.description: Find US federal contracts approaching expiration by NAICS code (option-year-aware index when available).

tools.name: recompete_search
tools.description: Search the option-year-aware Federal Recompete Radar index by NAICS, agency, stage (FINAL_PERIOD, BRIDGED, VEHICLE_SUNSET, OPTION_DECISION), set-aside, and award value.

tools.name: sec_8k_red_flags
tools.description: Search the live cross-company SEC Form 8-K Red-Flag index by item code (e.g. 1.05, 4.01, 4.02, 5.02), severity tier (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW), filing date, or issuer name.
